title: Deliver Coal to Fenfingway-on-sea Power Station
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Coal** delivered to **Fenfingway-on-sea Power Station** (industry id 1, near tile 53,72).

A likely supplier is **Pendingworth Coal Mine** (industry id 0, near tile 54,39); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
